findings.description: __aexit__ discards the exception arguments it receives and calls self.__exit__(None, None, None), so the sync exit path never sees the real exception.
findings.rationale: Trigger: an exception is raised inside `async with AttemptManager(...)`. The sync __exit__ branch shown at lines 214-215 records a successful result (set_result(None)) when no exception is passed, so the failed attempt is recorded as a success instead of set_exception(...) with the real exc info. Mechanism: the retry state never records the failure, so the retry logic does not treat the attempt as failed and does not retry it. Impact: a transient failure inside an async retry block is silently treated as success, and the retry behaviour the library exists to provide is lost.
